choice.basis: The dashboard's pie chart shows two slices: the light-gray slice is labeled 58% and the legend binds light-gray to Public Transit; the red slice is labeled 42% and the legend binds red to Car. The routing criterion is the majority-share transport mode. Since 58% > 50%, Public Transit holds the majority share, so the matching follow-up option is selected.
choice.option_label: Route Public Transit to majority-preference policy follow-up
